newsitem.title: USA: Bank of Commerce sets stock split.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Commerce sets stock split.

text.p: Bank of Commerce said Thursday its board of directors has approved a five-for-two split of its common stock to be issued May 5, to shareholders of record April 15.
Shareholder will receive 150 additional shares of common stock for every 100 shares currently owned. Cash payments will be made in lieu of fractional shares.
Bank of Commerce has about 2,012,209 shares outstanding and will have 5,030,522 shares outstanding after the new shares are issued.

"Bank of Commerce has achieved several successful years of solid growth and we believe in sharing our success with stockholders by paying this stock dividend," said President and Chief Executive Officer Peter Davis. "We believe the stock split will improve the trading liquidity of our shares."
